text:
Sana: quick heads-up — Maya (product infra) starts Mon. dropping a Day0/Day1 handoff + brief 30/60/90 asks so we can smooth the ramp :wave:

Raj: awesome, thanks Sana. do we have laptop + network access confirmed? who is doing the desk/badge setup?

IT-bot: created ticket #IT-4521 for laptop provisioning. ETA Mon morning if signature received. Maya, please upload your ssh pubkey here: `https://it.redwood/upload-key` or run:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "maya@redwood"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub | pbcopy
```

Maya: thanks — I’ll generate & upload tonight. quick Q: who should I ping for repo access (infra repos) and cloud projects?

Raj: ping me for repo invites. for GCP access, @Liam will kick off the IAM request with security. also pairing schedule: Tue morning 10–11 shadow with Nikhil, Wed 2pm infra design walkthrough.

Liam: will open IAM ticket once I get Maya’s GCP email. HR onboarding items: paperwork complete by EOD Tue, benefits walk Thu 3pm. I’ll DM the forms.

Sana: day1 agenda (high level):
- 9:30 intro + org tour (people-ops)
- 10:15 manager 1:1 (Raj) — role expectations + 30/60/90 goal sketch
- 11:00 security & SSO setup (Liam)
- 1:00 lunch with mentor (informal)
- 2:00 infra repo tour + quick task to run locally
- 4:30 end-of-day sync: blockers

Raj: 30/60/90 starters (draft):
- 30: onboarding completion + small infra fix deployed + docs updated
- 60: own one maintenance runbook + participate in oncall shadow
- 90: lead a small reliability improvement and present results

Maya: sounds great. for the small infra fix — any preferred starter tickets or microtasks?

Raj: yes, I’ll add two labeled `good-first-run` in the repo tonight. one is updating a CI step, the other is a tiny monitoring alert tweak.

IT-bot: badge pickup location: 3rd-floor reception. bring ID. building VPN instructions: `https://it.redwood/vpn-setup`

Liam: benefits checklist: enroll in health + commuter within 30 days to avoid coverage gaps. also sign the NDA form (sent via DocuSign).

Sana: mentor pairing: assigned to Nikhil for first 2 weeks. he’ll run a 30-min weekly sync to review context / questions.

Maya: perfect — thanks everyone. I’ll upload key tonight and fill the HR forms tomorrow AM. excited to join! :smile:

Raj: welcome again, Maya. we’ll get the calendar invites out by EOD (pairing + 1:1 + security).

Sana: I’ll post the consolidated checklist and links here in thread after invites — parking doc: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding/maya — feel free to add items. :white_check_mark:

Liam: added provisional invites for benefits/security.

IT-bot: ticket #IT-4521 updated: laptop assigned, shipping label generated.

Maya: got it, thanks — looking forward to Monday!
